verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a built-in auto-shutdown feature that stops a machine after a configurable inactivity period of one hour to one week. That directly addresses the forgotten-instance scenario, and the story asks for timers OR spend limits. Missing for 10: any documented spend limits or billing alerts, wall-clock (non-inactivity) shutdown timers, API/CLI configuration detail for auto-shutdown, and independent hands-on corroboration that it works.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can set auto-shutdown timers or spend limits so a forgotten instance can't silently run up a huge bill

citations.quote: The auto-shutdown feature places your machine in a stop state after a predefined period of inactivity, which can range from one hour to one week.
